text: 上海市商务委等七部门印发《上海市国家服务贸易创新发展示范区建设方案》。其中指出，吸引企业和机构设立人工智能研发中心、开源平台和合作实验室。推动算力和基础大模型扩大境外调用，支持智能体、多模态生成等模型产品出口。推动具身智能等智能终端企业拓展全周期服务新模式。支持人工智能赋能医疗、教育、专业服务等行业。办好世界人工智能大会和全球开发者活动，加快世界人工智能合作组织总部建设。支持浦东新区建设人工智能创新应用先导区，支持徐汇区建设“模速空间”大模型创新生态社区。探索建立人工智能全球治理体系。
text_en: The Shanghai Municipal Commerce Commission and six other departments issued the 'Shanghai National Service Trade Innovation Development Demonstration Zone Construction Plan.' It calls for attracting companies and institutions to set up AI R&D centers, open-source platforms, and collaborative laboratories. It aims to promote overseas calls of computing power and foundational large models, and support exports of model products like agents and multimodal generation. It also supports embodied intelligence and other intelligent terminal companies in expanding full-cycle service models. AI empowerment for industries such as healthcare, education, and professional services is supported. The plan includes hosting the World Artificial Intelligence Conference and global developer events, and accelerating the construction of the World AI Cooperation Organization headquarters. It supports Pudong New Area in building an AI innovation application pilot zone and Xuhui District in building the 'Model Space' large-model innovation ecosystem community. It also explores establishing a global AI governance system.
